title: An empty book
note: The closed cover named and signed in first run, one plain sentence, one action: "Write a letter". No counts, no gaps, nothing to fill in. With one book there is no "For Asha" row: "Asha's book" already says the name.
text: Asha's book Asha From Mama The first page is waiting. Tell Asha one thing about today. Write a letter Tonight Book Family
lines: Tell Asha one thing about today.
